chronology_and_limits: Use the source completed-year convention:1326 complete years, not1327 complete years.2July1327 is modern shorthand for its explicit incomplete-year1327 example.
The opening rule uses365days per completed year plus the integer quarter-year count, and distinguishes bissextile month rows. This is not modern Gregorian conversion.
484504 is the source era day tally, not a asserted Julian Day Number; do not import a day-zero convention or real flood date.
The preserved edition is1483. Its worked1327 example does not by itself date this copy or prove every textual detail was available earlier.
